We have a conflict on axis "num":

- register: "R049/2006-FR2-2013.01 Rev. 1"
- document: "R49 : 2006-FR2-13.01 rev. 1"

These denote the same OIML certificate number. The register form is canonical: "R049/2006-FR2-2013.01 Rev. 1" — R049 is the OIML recommendation R49, year 2006, issuing authority FR2 (France/LNE), certificate number 2013.01, revision 1. The document writes "R49 : 2006-FR2-13.01 rev. 1" — same certificate, just formatting differences (R49 vs R049, 13.01 vs 2013.01, lowercase "rev."). Per rules: "Number/year format differences that clearly denote the same certificate = same-entity with the register's canonical form."

So verdict: same-entity, best_value = register value "R049/2006-FR2-2013.01 Rev. 1".
